metric_definitions.win_pct: ATS for spread; O/U win percentage for total
metric_definitions.roi: total realized profit divided by units risked; preserved American price where available
metric_definitions.avg_clv: Spread CLV is points from the selected wager team perspective: entry line minus closing line. Positive means the bettor beat the close.
metric_definitions.beat_close_pct: positive point CLV including unchanged closes in denominator
metric_definitions.clv_implied_ev: null unless a validated market-specific conversion exists
metric_definitions.independent_checkpoint: fresh signals selected independently at each checkpoint
metric_definitions.matched_decay: same origin game, side, wager, and threshold followed through later checkpoints

coverage.spread: Saturday 11 PM is partial; Friday 2021 absent; checkpoint samples differ.
coverage.total: Only preserved Sunday and close checkpoints; no Monday-Friday Total history.
coverage.dratings_total: Prospective 2026 identity; historical cohort too limited for equivalent validation.
